summary: In this story, a boy who struggles with spelling practices every day with his teacher's encouragement and does his personal best at the school spelling bee.
introduce: Show the title “The Spelling Bee Champion” and ask, “What do you think will happen in this story, and why?” Explain that good readers use clues in the text together with what they already know to make inferences.

keyTerms.def: to give someone support or confidence to do something
a feeling of trust in your own ability to do something
to get better at something over time

challengeTerms.def: the quality of continuing to try, even when something is difficult
a part of a word that contains one vowel sound
something that is successfully accomplished through effort

discussion: Do you agree or disagree that winning is the only thing that matters in a competition? Use evidence from the story to explain.
Explain how Yousef's daily practice and his teacher's encouragement helped him improve.
struggling: Pre-teach encourage, confidence, and improve with pictures or gestures, then let weak readers answer “What clue tells you that?” questions using sentence starters.
gifted: Ask strong readers to read a challenging version and write a short paragraph that uses perseverance, syllable, and achievement to make an inference that the story does not state and support it with two clues.
